Future<bool> isFree(int i) async => true;
Future<void> save(int i) async {}

// CASE multi_break expect=pass
Future<int> b1(List<int> ids) async {
  var found = -1;
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) {
      found = ids[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  return found;
}

// CASE multi_delay_tail expect=pass
Future<void> b2(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return;
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
  }
}

// CASE single_return expect=pass
Future<int> b3(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE single_break expect=pass
Future<int> b4(List<int> ids) async {
  var found = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) {
      found = ids[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  return found;
}

// CASE empty_update_return expect=pass
Future<int> b5(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = ids.length; i-- > 0;) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE multi_return_value_only expect=pass
Future<int> b6(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    return await isFree(ids[i]) ? ids[i] : -1;
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE multi_throw expect=pass
Future<void> b7(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (!await isFree(ids[i])) throw StateError('busy');
  }
}

// CASE single_throw expect=pass
Future<void> b8(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (!await isFree(ids[i])) throw StateError('busy');
  }
}
